== Original and remastered English issuer text ==
The remaster redevelops the Effect as a site deployment with a permanent-weapon destiny penalty and draw-phase Force action. The May slip prints collector 49, while the December 2006 slip prints collector 50. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16602#page=4 Players Committee original sheet, p. 4, slip 49]. [[:File:VS9O-50-Wipe_Them_Out_All_Of_Them.png|Publisher slip]]. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards9.pdf#page=4 Players Committee remastered sheet, p. 4, slip 50]. The original slip credits Michael Raveling’s design and the 2004 Minnesota State win.
